rationale: C08 is a highly plausible direct template: it is an earlier Eisenhower letter accepting the resignation of McElroy's immediate predecessor in the same office, and it shares both the later letter's progression and unusually specific material. Both accept the Secretary of Defense's resignation with personal regret, emphasize the exceptional burdens and complex management responsibilities of the office, credit the secretary's leadership with strengthening defense operations, anticipate a continuing departmental legacy, thank him for strong personal support, and close with warm personal regard. C03 and C11 contain some parallel gratitude, legacy, and future-assistance language, but neither matches C08's office-specific machinery and sustained structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As I regretfully accept your resignation as Secretary of Defense... I wish to express my deep appreciation of your distinguished service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I deeply regret that the time is rapidly approaching when you will leave Government service... I must of course accept your resignation as Secretary of Defense
shared_material.explanation: Both open by coupling acceptance of the same cabinet resignation with emphatic personal regret.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the extraordinary burdens imposed by its responsibility for day-to-day management of the huge national security complex encompassed by the Department of Defense
shared_material.parent_excerpt: your effective leadership and successful management of very complex responsibilities
shared_material.explanation: Both characterize the Defense post through unusually heavy, complex management responsibilities.

shared_material.child_excerpt: you leave to your successor a Department that will continue to reflect the very beneficial changes effected under your energetic leadership
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the continuing readiness of our armed forces will be a lasting satisfaction to you... you will be available for consultation with Mr. McElroy as he assumes these heavy responsibilities
shared_material.explanation: Both connect the departing secretary's leadership to an enduring defense legacy and transition to his successor.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am deeply grateful for the strong support you have consistently afforded... me
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For the friendship and strong support you have given me... I have been deeply and constantly grateful
shared_material.explanation: This is close, distinctive shared language in the personal-gratitude paragraph.
Identical closing, supportive but not independently probative.
